title: Najee Harris Base Card 2023 Panini Prizm Football #252 Pittsburgh Steelers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare and exclusive 2023 Panini Prizm sports trading card featuring the Pittsburgh Steelers' very own Najee Harris. Made from high-quality cardstock and gleaming chrome, this card is perfect for collectors and fans alike. With holograms and a star-studded design, this card is sure to be a hit.

Celebrate the upcoming football season with this limited edition, first edition, insert card. Complete your set with this short print, promo, parallel/variety, base set, and checklist card. Don't miss out on the chance to add this exclusive and highly sought-after card to your collection.
